top_papers.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
top_papers.abstract: Quantization is widely used to reduce the computational and memory demands of neural-network inference. In recurrent networks, however, the quantized state is stored and returned at the next time step, so the rule used to store that state can alter subsequent computations.
